templates.title: Fitness Today
templates.description: Daily activity page: Day/Week/Month switch, activity rings with move/exercise/stand values, steps, water and sleep.

templates.title: Shop Home
templates.description: Shopping app shell with a bottom tab bar: home tab (search, category chips, promo, product), cart tab (cart summary, coupon, order tracking) and an empty state for the other tabs.

templates.title: Wallet Home
templates.description: Finance home: balance card, monthly budget donut, recent transactions and a stock card.

templates.title: Profile & Settings
templates.description: Profile card, a notifications switch row, settings list and theme toggle.

templates.title: Sign In / Sign Up
templates.description: Login form that switches to a sign-up form with a password strength meter.

templates.title: Now Playing
templates.description: Music player page: track card with play/pause and progress (advanced by a timer), waveform, equalizer and volume.

templates.title: Weather Today
templates.description: Weather page: current conditions, hourly forecast, sunrise/sunset arc and radar.

templates.title: Watch Health
templates.description: Round-watch app with vertically swiped screens and page dots: heart rate, steps, activity rings, blood oxygen, sleep.

templates.title: Watch Workout
templates.description: Workout app for the watch, vertically swiped: workout stats, heart rate, stopwatch, music controls.

templates.title: Watch Home
templates.description: Everyday watch app, vertically swiped: digital watch face, weather, calendar, reminders, smart home.

templates.title: Desktop Workspace
templates.description: PC/tablet window with top tabs switching between an analytics dashboard, kanban board, month calendar and inbox. The panels are animated mockups driven by a step counter.
